<!--
  One customer quote of TestimonialGrid: a card, a plain figure or a social post, with the author's picture, the
  stars and a company glyph as `item` says.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Quote, QuoteLabels, QuoteItem } from "../blocks/testimonial-grid.types";

  export type QuoteCardProps = {
    q: Quote;
    labels: QuoteLabels;
    item?: QuoteItem;
    layout?: "grid" | "single" | "stack" | "masonry" | "strip";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Rating from "../components/rating.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { q, labels, item, layout = "grid" }: QuoteCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="figure"
  class={cn(
    "m-0 flex flex-col gap-4",
    ((item?.kind === "plain") ? "" : "rounded p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border bg-card"),
    (
      (layout as string) === "masonry" ? "mb-4 break-inside-avoid"
      : (layout as string) === "strip" ? "w-80 shrink-0 snap-start"
      : "h-full"
    )
  )}
  data-testid="item"
>
  {#if (item?.kind === "social")}
    <Group gap="4" align="center">
      {#if (item?.avatar !== "none")}
        <MediaFrame alt={q.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="0">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {q.author}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl(labels.handleLine, q.handle, q.time)}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <LucideIcon name="message-circle" size={16} class="ml-auto text-muted-foreground" />
    </Group>
    <Text size="base">
      {q.quote}
    </Text>
  {:else}
    {#if (item?.rating !== "hide")}
      <Rating value={q.rating} label={tpl(labels.rating, q.rating)} size={16} />
    {/if}
    {#if (item?.mark === "icon")}
      <Inline class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="mark">
        <LucideIcon name={q.mark} size={24} />
      </Inline>
    {/if}
    <Text size={(((layout as string) === "single") ? "xl" : "base")}>
      {q.quote}
    </Text>
    <Group gap="4" align="center">
      {#if (item?.avatar !== "none")}
        <MediaFrame alt={q.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="0">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {q.author}
        </Text>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl(labels.byLine, q.role, q.company)}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
  {/if}
</Block>
